# CurseForge test fixtures

`modpack-files.json` is HAND-MADE, not a recorded response: no CurseForge API key was available when the spec 035 fixtures were written. It follows the shape the API's engine decodes for `GET /v1/mods/{modId}/files` (`{"data": [cfFile...]}`, see `cfFile` in `api/internal/registry/curseforge.go`: `id`, `displayName`, `fileName`, `downloadUrl`, `fileLength`, `gameVersions`), plus the other fields the real API returns (`modId`, `releaseType`, `fileDate`, `pagination`) which the decoder ignores. The pack is a made-up class 4471 (Modpacks) project with files that mix Minecraft versions and loaders in `gameVersions` (NeoForge/Forge/Fabric, in different orders, plus `Client` and `Java 8`) and one file with `"downloadUrl": null` (distribution disabled). Replace it with a real recorded response when a key is available (`curl -H "x-api-key: $KEY" "https://api.curseforge.com/v1/mods/<id>/files?pageSize=50"`).
